en.name: Preacher
en.ability: Each night, choose a player: a Minion, if chosen, learns this. All chosen Minions have no ability.

zh.name: 传教士
zh.ability:
每个夜晚，你要选择一名玩家：如果你选中了爪牙，他会得知被传教士选中。
所有被你选中的爪牙失去能力。
